# EvLogo

> Both brand lockups from the Figma Logo page, drawn from shipped SVG: the EVOQ mark, wordmark and tagline, and the DataSea mark and wordmark. A local asset can replace them.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:logo` |
| Layer | Atom (`src/atoms`) |
| Import | `import { EvLogo } from 'evoq-ui'` |
| Template tag | `<EvLogo>` or `<ev-logo>` |
| Source | `src/atoms/logo/EvLogo.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the root `<span class="ev-logo">` |

## Example

```vue
<EvLogo :size="64" />
```

_The exact snippet the playground simulator copies for this component (`playground/simulator-demos.ts`)._

## Props (6)

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `brand` | `'evoq'` \| `'datasea'` | `'evoq'` | no | Which lockup: the EVOQ product logo, or the DataSea company logo. |
| `variant` | `'lockup'` \| `'mark'` \| `'wordmark'` | `'lockup'` | no | The whole lockup, or one part of it on its own. |
| `size` | `number \| string` | `40` | no | Rendered height, in px for a number. The width follows the lockup. |
| `src` | `string` | — | no | An image to use instead of the built-in logo - a local asset, or any URL. Leave it unset and the component draws the Figma logo. |
| `label` | `string` | — | no | Accessible name. Defaults to the brand's name; set it to an empty string for a logo that is purely decorative. |
| `tagline` | `boolean` | `true` | no | Draw the "Procure to Pay Evolution" line under the wordmark. Only the EVOQ lockup has one; DataSea ignores it. |

## Slots (1)

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `default` | Replaces the logo entirely - for a lockup this package does not ship, such as a co-branded one. Takes precedence over `src`. |

## Events (0)

None.

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvLogo`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the root `<span class="ev-logo">`.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:logo` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
